name: Brute-force login protection
evidence: Sent 20 wrong password attempts — never blocked, never throttled
recommendation: Add rate limiting: 5 failed attempts per email per 15 min → lock

name: 2FA brute-force protection
evidence: 12 OTP guesses accepted without throttle (all returned non-429)
recommendation: Rate-limit /2fa/verify to 5 attempts per user_id per 15 min, then invalidate the code

name: Forgot-password rate limiting
evidence: 12 requests sent without 429 — no rate limiting on password reset

name: Unauthenticated file upload
recommendation: Require Bearer token for all uploads; remove the optional-auth fallback

name: Missing HTTP security headers
evidence: Missing: x-content-type-options, x-frame-options, strict-transport-security, content-security-policy, x-xss-protection, referrer-policy
recommendation: Add SecurityHeadersMiddleware returning X-Frame-Options, HSTS, CSP, etc.

name: Open redirect
evidence: No unvalidated redirect to external domains detected

name: Sensitive data in error responses
evidence: Error responses contain no stack traces or internal paths

name: Password strength on reset
evidence: Cannot verify without valid reset token — static analysis shows only min-length (8) is checked, not complexity
recommendation: Apply same password_strength validator from RegisterRequest to ResetPasswordRequest

name: Email verification brute-force
evidence: 15 random token guesses on /verify-email — never throttled (no 429)
recommendation: Rate-limit /verify-email to 5 attempts per IP per hour

name: Media directory listing
evidence: GET /media/ returned HTTP 404 — no directory listing
